name: Agrus Kos
title: Wojek Investigator
summary: A determined wojek whose pursuit of a secret guildmaster helped unmake Ravnica's first Guildpact.
biography: Agrus Kos served the Boros Legion as a veteran wojek, pursuing crimes that exposed the fault lines between Ravnica's ten guilds.
His investigation into Szadek helped reveal House Dimir's conspiracy, but the vampire's arrest was also the trigger for the original Guildpact's collapse.
Agrus continued to confront the consequences of the broken pact alongside allies such as Teysa Karlov.

Kos approached Ravnica's conspiracies through the ordinary practices of investigation: following witnesses, confronting corruption, and pursuing people who had hidden behind institutional power. His position as a wojek placed him inside the Boros system while requiring him to ask questions across guild boundaries.

The first Guildpact's destruction is crucial precisely because he did not set out to destroy it. Szadek engineered a paradox in the magical contract, and Augustin IV anticipated the result. Kos acted on evidence against a dangerous vampire, only to discover that lawful enforcement could help break the law governing the city itself.

After that rupture, Kos and his allies faced more than a single arrested villain. Ravnica still needed political order even without the binding settlement that had structured guild competition for millennia. His story therefore moves from solving a crime toward confronting the consequences of a system whose rules had been weaponized.

featuredCard.significance: A later printing of the Boros investigator introduced in Ravnica's first story cycle.
